info.description: Team360 Health Check Application REST API. Assesses team health across 11 dimensions with hierarchical org support.
info.title: Team360 API

get.description: Returns all organizational hierarchy levels (e.g. VP, Director, Manager). Requires admin (level-1) role.

post.description: Creates a new organizational hierarchy level, appended at the end of the position order. Requires admin (level-1) role.

500.description: Failed to determine position or create hierarchy level

put.description: Updates a hierarchy level's name and/or permissions. Requires admin (level-1) role.

delete.description: Deletes a hierarchy level. Fails if any users are still assigned to it. Requires admin (level-1) role.

409.description: Users are assigned to this level

500.description: Database error or failed to delete hierarchy level

put.description: Moves a hierarchy level to a new position, shifting the other levels accordingly. Requires admin (level-1) role.

500.description: Failed to start transaction, reorder levels, update position, or commit

get.description: Returns the company name and logo URL used for branding. Requires admin (level-1) role.

put.description: Updates the company name and/or logo URL (base64 data URL capped at ~500KB). Requires admin (level-1) role.

400.description: Invalid request body or logo too large

get.description: Returns all health dimensions, including inactive ones. Requires admin (level-1) role.

post.description: Creates a new health dimension. Weight must be between 0 and 10 (defaults to 1.0); isActive defaults to true. Requires admin (level-1) role.

400.description: Invalid request body or weight out of range

put.description: Updates a health dimension's fields. Weight must be between 0 and 10. Requires admin (level-1) role.

400.description: Invalid request body or weight out of range

delete.description: Deletes a health dimension. Requires admin (level-1) role.

get.description: Returns notification configuration (email/Slack enabled, submission reminders, SMTP status). Requires admin (level-1) role.

put.description: Updates notification configuration (email/Slack enabled, weekly digest). Requires admin (level-1) role.

get.description: Returns the data retention policy (months to keep sessions, anonymization window). Requires admin (level-1) role.

put.description: Updates the data retention policy. keepSessionsMonths must be between 1 and 120. Requires admin (level-1) role.

400.description: Invalid request body or keepSessionsMonths out of range

get.description: Returns all teams with full admin details (team lead, cadence, distribution list, member count). Requires admin (level-1) role.

post.description: Creates a new team. If a team lead is set, the supervisor chain is auto-derived from their reports-to hierarchy. Requires admin (level-1) role.

put.description: Updates a team's name, lead, cadence, and/or distribution list email. Re-derives (or clears) the supervisor chain if the team lead changes. Requires admin (level-1) role.

delete.description: Deletes a team. Requires admin (level-1) role.

get.description: Returns the members of a team. Requires admin (level-1) role.

post.description: Adds a user as a member of a team. Requires admin (level-1) role.
post.summary: Add a member to a team

404.description: Team not found or user not found

delete.description: Removes a user from a team's membership. Requires admin (level-1) role.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a team

get.description: Returns the team's supervisor chain (derived from the team lead's reports-to hierarchy), enriched with user and level names. Requires admin (level-1) role.

put.description: Overwrites the team's supervisor chain with the given list. Requires admin (level-1) role.

get.description: Returns all users. Requires admin (level-1) role.

post.description: Creates a new user (local or SSO auth type). Local users require a password. Requires admin (level-1) role.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing/short password for local user

500.description: Failed to hash password or create user

put.description: Updates a user's profile, role, auth type, and/or password. Re-derives supervisor chains if reportsTo or hierarchy level changes. Requires admin (level-1) role.

400.description: Invalid request body, invalid authType, cannot set password for SSO user, or password required when switching to local auth

500.description: Failed to hash password, update user, or update password

delete.description: Deletes a user. Requires admin (level-1) role.

get.description: Returns the distinct assessment periods that have submitted health check data, for populating dropdowns.

post.description: Creates a password reset token and emails a reset link. Always returns success (even for unknown emails) to prevent email enumeration. Public endpoint.
Authenticates a local user via username/password and issues a JWT access/refresh token pair. Public endpoint — SSO users cannot log in here.
post.summary: Log in with username and password

401.description: Invalid credentials, SSO-only user, or token generation failed

post.description: Logs the user out. For stateless JWT, this is handled client-side by discarding tokens; the endpoint records the logout event. Public endpoint (works with or without a valid session).
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token. Public endpoint.

401.description: Invalid or expired refresh token, or user no longer exists

post.description: Resets a user's password given a valid reset token. Public endpoint.
post.summary: Reset password using a reset token

400.description: Missing token/password or password too short

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code + PKCE verifier for the OAuth provider's tokens, resolves the user by email, and issues our own JWT access/refresh token pair. Public endpoint.

401.description: Token exchange failed, no account found, or account does not support SSO

503.description: SSO is not configured on this server

get.description: Returns SSO settings and branding info (company name, logo) so the frontend can render the login page and "Sign in with SSO" button without baking values in at build time. No authentication required.

200.description: appEnv, companyName, logoURL, and sso (null or {clientId, authorizeUrl, redirectUri, scopes})

get.description: Returns 200 with a simple status payload. Used by tests and load balancers. Public endpoint.

post.description: Submits a team member's health check responses for an assessment period. Fires an async email notification on success.

400.description: Invalid request body, invalid date, invalid/future assessment period, or command failure

get.description: Returns all health check sessions submitted for a team, optionally filtered by assessment period.
get.summary: List a team's health check sessions

get.description: Returns a single health check session and its dimension responses.
get.summary: Get a health check session by ID

get.description: Returns the currently active health dimensions used to build the survey (e.g. Mission, Speed, Fun).
Returns aggregated per-dimension average scores across all teams supervised by the given manager, for a radar chart. Requires manager-or-above role and same-user-or-manager access.
get.summary: Get aggregated radar chart data for a manager

get.description: Returns per-dimension trend data across assessment periods, aggregated over all teams supervised by the given manager. Requires manager-or-above role and same-user-or-manager access.
get.summary: Get trend data for a manager's supervised teams

get.description: Returns the full subordinate tree (direct and indirect reports) for the given manager, for org hierarchy display. Requires manager-or-above role and same-user-or-manager access.
Returns each supervised team's open (non-done) action item count. Requires manager-or-above role; caller may only request their own summary.
get.summary: Get open action item counts across a manager's teams

403.description: Forbidden — can only view your own summary

get.description: Returns per-team health summaries (submission count, overall health, per-dimension averages) for all teams supervised by the given manager. Requires manager-or-above role and same-user-or-manager access.
get.summary: Get aggregated team health for a manager

get.description: Returns a list of all teams with summary info (name, cadence, member count, team lead). Available to any authenticated user.
Returns action items for a team, optionally filtered by status and/or assessment period. Requires team membership.

post.description: Creates a new action item for a team. If assignedTo is set, the user must be a member of the team. Requires team membership.

400.description: Invalid request, invalid dueDate, or assignedTo not a team member

500.description: Failed to validate assignee or create action item

delete.description: Deletes an action item belonging to a team. Requires team membership.

patch.description: Partially updates an action item's fields. If assignedTo is set, the user must be a member of the team. Requires team membership.

400.description: Invalid request, invalid status/dueDate, or assignedTo not a team member

500.description: Failed to validate assignee or update action item

get.description: Returns radar chart data: overall health and per-dimension average scores for a team, optionally filtered by assessment period. Requires team membership.

500.description: Database query failed or failed to parse dimension data

get.description: Returns individual (non-anonymized) team member survey responses with per-dimension scores and comments, optionally filtered by assessment period. Requires team membership.

500.description: Database query failed or failed to parse response data

get.description: Returns red/yellow/green score counts per dimension for a bar chart, optionally filtered by assessment period. Requires team membership.

500.description: Database query failed or failed to parse distribution data

get.description: Returns per-dimension trend data across assessment periods for a team. Requires team membership.
Returns team details (name, cadence, team lead, members). Requires team membership.
Returns all health check sessions for a team, optionally filtered by assessment period. Requires team membership.
get.summary: List a team's health check sessions

get.description: Returns how many team members have submitted a health check for the given assessment period, and whether a post-workshop survey exists.
get.summary: Get a team's submission status for a period

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user, derived from JWT claims plus a full-name lookup.
Returns a user's past health check submissions with per-dimension responses, optionally filtered by assessment period and limited in count. Requires same-user-or-manager access.

parameters.description: Max number of sessions to return (default 10)
parameters.name: limit

500.description: Database query failed or failed to parse survey history data

id.description: Optional - will be auto-generated from name if not provided

name.description: Required - used to generate ID if not provided

id.description: Optional - will be auto-generated from name if not provided

name.description: Required - used to generate ID if not provided

id.description: Optional - will be auto-generated from username if not provided

password.description: Required for local users, omit for SSO users

username.description: Required - used to generate ID if not provided

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
